section.title: Out of Scope
section.description: - List requirements and features excluded from the MVP. - Record only confirmed exclusions and known technical debt. Do not invent future work, technology selections, metrics, or dates to fill this section. - Use tables when there are actual items, naming their user/operational consequence and reason. Record a target phase only when supplied or approved; otherwise use "Not scheduled". - Both subsections still require confirmation. When there are no items, record that fact in a short statement rather than creating placeholder rows.

subsection.title: Deferred Features
subsection.example: No product behavior was explicitly deferred.

subsection.title: Technical Debt Roadmap
subsection.description: Document known technical debt and its observable consequences, not generic best-practice work. If none is known, say so. Unresolved product decisions are questions to settle, not technical debt to silently defer.
